acceptanceCriteria.text: Comment, card, card-attempt evidence, epic-attempt evidence and ticket views carry missing: true exactly on images whose bytes are not stored.
Present images have no missing key, and no stored record, bundle or content hash changes.
The listed tests pass, plus npm run typecheck and oxlint on touched files.

body: The gallery already draws its placeholder from `item.missing` (src/renderer/src/attachments/AttachmentGallery.tsx:10-13,36), but no view sets it: `AttachmentRef` has no such field (src/shared/domain/views.ts:1093-1102). Today a missing image is found only when the fails (onError, line 52). ## Do 1. src/shared/domain/views.ts:1093-1102: add `missing?: true` to `AttachmentRef`, documented "Set only by read views when this database holds no bytes for the image; never stored or hashed." 2. src/core/services/attachments.ts, after `listAttachmentRefs` (line 246), export: - `flagMissingAttachments(db: Db, refs: readonly AttachmentRef[]): AttachmentRef[]`: empty input returns a copy; otherwise one query `SELECT id FROM attachments WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND id IN (?,…)`; return each ref unchanged if found, else `{ ...ref, missing: true }` (a missing row and NULL data both count). - `flagMissingEvidence(db: Db, evidence: E | null): E | null`: unchanged when null or without attachments; else with attachments flagged. 3. Apply them in these read paths only: - src/core/services/comments.ts:30: wrap with flagMissingAttachments(db, …). - src/core/services/kanban/cards.ts:171 (cardAttachments): wrap with flagMissingAttachments(ctx.db, …). - src/core/services/kanban/cards.ts:165: map attempts so each view's evidence goes through flagMissingEvidence(ctx.db, view.evidence). - src/core/services/execution.ts:307 (listAttempts): after .map(attemptView), map each to { ...view, evidence: flagMissingEvidence(ctx.db, view.evidence) }. - src/core/services/tickets.ts:127 (getTicket): when ticket.attachments is defined, return the ticket with flagged attachments. 4. Leave listAttachmentRefs, attachmentRefOf, claimEvidenceAttachments, portable.ts and every write or export path untouched, so nothing stored or hashed gains the key. ## Out of scope Renderer changes (the gallery already honours missing), attemptView callers other than listAttempts, StorageCard, the protocol handler. ## Tests - src/core/services/attachments.test.ts, new describe('flagMissingAttachments'): flags a row with NULL data and an id with no row; leaves a stored image without a missing key; returns [] for []. - src/core/services/comments.test.ts near line 302: after UPDATE attachments SET data = NULL, missing = 1, listComments returns that ref with missing: true and the other without the key. - src/core/services/kanban/cards.test.ts near line 516: getKanbanCard flags a card image whose data was nulled. - src/core/services/kanban/attempts.test.ts near line 121: getKanbanCard(...).attempts[0].evidence.attachments[0].missing is true after nulling. - src/core/services/attempts.test.ts in describe('submitAttempt — attachments') (line 689): listAttempts flags nulled evidence images. - src/core/services/tickets.test.ts: getTicket (saved view) flags a nulled ticket image; the stored plan_revisions.bundle_json still has no missing key. ## Rules This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Flag missing images in the gallery before loading them
